description: Connects human genes to Gene Ontology biological processes through direct NCBI gene2go annotations or annotations propagated to ancestor terms through is_a and part_of relationships.

common_properties.name: qualifier
common_properties.description: The gene2go annotation qualifier; propagated-only associations use ["inferred"].
common_properties.notes: The `qualifier` and `evidence` lists are positionally aligned — `qualifier[i]` corresponds to `evidence[i]`, representing one distinct annotation row from gene2go. Only unique (qualifier, evidence) pairs are stored per edge; duplicates arising from different PubMed support are collapsed.

common_properties.name: evidence
common_properties.description: GO evidence codes from gene2go, such as IDA, IEA, IBA, TAS, and IMP; propagated-only associations use ["inferred"].

common_properties.name: unbiased
common_properties.description: False: GO annotations are a curated (biased) set.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time when the association was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Human annotations (tax_id = 9606) for genes present in SPOKE and non-obsolete biological-process terms whose final annotated-gene set contains 2–1000 genes inclusive. All non-NOT qualifiers are retained. Negative annotations exclude the gene from the specified term, including associations otherwise inferred by propagation.
source_contributions.description: Direct annotations supply qualifier and evidence pairs. Propagation follows is_a and part_of relationships, including cross-namespace relationships from molecular functions to biological processes. When an association has both direct and propagated support, only the direct qualifier/evidence pairs are retained; "inferred" is never appended to direct evidence.
